capabilities: Fetch a pasted or dropped URL's title and insert a Markdown link
Title URLs already in a note via commands
Clean titles with site-name removal and find-and-replace rules
Fetch titles from a Templater script
disambiguation: Not a general link converter or editor; it only titles URLs as they are pasted, dropped, or selected.
extras: Opt-in FxTwitter lookups send x.com/twitter.com URLs to the third-party fxtwitter.com or fixupx.com; no telemetry. Own plugin id, so Auto Link Title settings need importing from the settings tab, and both plugins should not run at once. No command has a default hotkey. Some mobile keyboards do not fire a paste event; use the 'Paste URL and fetch its title' command.
motivation: The author forked Auto Link Title because that project has been inactive since December 2024, to fix its reported bugs and avoid running every site's scripts in a hidden browser window.
problem: Obsidian pastes a bare URL with no title, so links have to be named by hand.

relations.evidence: In a Templater template, this turns the selected URL into a titled link

summary: Link titler that fetches a pasted or dropped URL's page title and inserts it as a Markdown link, with templates and title clean-up rules.
